recommendation: Keep the fix. Do not remove current DeviceDefinition.url for FHIR-26310; further canonical-modeling changes should be handled under the later FHIR-39389/FHIR-42900 family.
issue_request: FHIR-26310 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked to remove DeviceDefinition.url, or clarify another purpose, because the original element described a network address for an actual device instance; the accepted rationale was that only actual devices have addressable endpoints.
initial_application: The endpoint-style DeviceDefinition.url existed in early R4B/R5 source as "Network address to contact device". Later conversion notes record "DeviceDefinition.url= Removed - only instances have addressable endpoints", and git history shows the element absent before the later canonical-resource work.
additional_context: FHIR-39389 and FHIR-42900 later changed DeviceDefinition to specialize CanonicalResource, intentionally reintroducing DeviceDefinition.url as a canonical identifier rather than as a device endpoint. DeviceDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini, and FHIR-53212 later marked the DeviceDefinition URL search parameter normative/active.
reconciliation: Changed source/devicedefinition/bundle-DeviceDefinition-search-params.xml so DeviceDefinition-url says it identifies the device definition instead of the code system. The canonical DeviceDefinition.url element itself was left intact because it now has a distinct, later-approved purpose.
source_changes: source/devicedefinition/bundle-DeviceDefinition-search-params.xml: changed the DeviceDefinition-url SearchParameter description from "The uri that identifies the code system" to "The uri that identifies the device definition".

related_jiras.note: Records the later definitional-resource modeling decision that makes a canonical URL appropriate for DeviceDefinition.
